notes: Third time this month Kesh has finished off a surrendered enemy. Tonight he didn't even hesitate, and he was smiling after. The others have noticed.

gold.darkWhy: finishing off the surrendered, smiling: the contract's own example (cruelty/serious)

notes: Saoirse used the charm to make the innkeeper's son do her chores, then made him give her his savings. She's been doing it to people for weeks and says it doesn't count because they 'wanted to'.

gold.darkWhy: charm used for weeks to take people's will and savings

notes: Grell can't go a night without the black lotus now. He sold his shield for another dose and fought the ghouls half-dazed. Still won, somehow.

gold.darkWhy: a compulsion that costs him his gear; the harm falls mostly on himself

notes: Wick sold out the smugglers who'd sheltered us, to the Watch, for 50 gold. He had drinks with them the night before.

gold.darkWhy: sold out the people who sheltered the party, for gold

notes: Aurel desecrated the shrine of his own god to power the ward that saved the village. He hasn't prayed since. His holy symbol has gone cold.

gold.darkWhy: desecrated his own god's shrine (for a good end; still the deed)

notes: Nereth made the bargain with the thing in the well: a year of her life for the spell that sealed the rift. She looks older already.

gold.darkWhy: a bargain with a thing in a well; the price is her own

notes: Tovin broke the captured scout's will over three days until he'd say anything. We got the camp location. Nobody at the table enjoyed that scene.

gold.darkWhy: broke a captive over three days: torture for information (serious), arguably monstrous

notes: Mara has started taking a trophy from everyone she kills with her bow. She keeps them on a cord. It's up to nine.

gold.darkWhy: a trophy from every kill: killing has become something she collects

notes: Kip robbed the temple's alms box again, the one for plague orphans. Third time. He says he'll pay it back.

gold.darkWhy: robbing the plague orphans' temple alms, repeatedly: past petty theft

notes: Esk raised the dead bandits to carry our gear across the pass. She didn't ask anyone first, and she's done it every day since.

gold.darkWhy: raised the dead as porters without asking, every day since
